result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but it omits workers’ compensation as required by law. It also adds an unnecessary one-year post-term maintenance obligation not required by the playbook. Renumbering Force Majeure to Section 31 without updating Section 24’s survival reference changes the original survival scope by including the new insurance provision while excluding Force Majeure, contrary to the margin comment and unrelated commercial intent.
